flags.text: 12 Elisa BreakOut Series 2 fixtures are best-of-one on HLTV (every other open fixture is best-of-three). A single map gives the underdog a much better chance than a series, so these picks carry more upset risk. Format recorded for the same rows by mobile/ (e3315a54): BO1; by model/ (91eff436) best_of: (blank).

Hotspawn and EGamersWorld call this event 'CCT Europe 2026 Series #12 Play-In'; HLTV calls it 'CCT 2026 Europe Series 12 Closed Qualifier'. Teams, kickoff and format agree, so this looks like a naming difference only. The Hotspawn lobby shows no match link for these 4 rows.

Hotspawn's 'WROTBERRY' appears as 'WBT' on HLTV and EGamersWorld in exactly the same 3 slots (same event, kickoff and opponent: EAC 08:00, ENCE 12:00, BOJONG 16:00 on 15 Oct). That slot match is strong evidence they are the same team, but no official page states that WBT is short for WROTBERRY. Treated as matched by schedule only; not verified by name.

HLTV lists these teams in the opposite order to Hotspawn (Hotspawn SUKEBAN vs your end = HLTV your end vs SUKEBAN; Hotspawn Ryvex vs PCIFIC = HLTV PCIFIC vs Ryvex; Hotspawn RoundsGG vs Voca = HLTV Voca vs ROUNDS). All prices on this page are shown in Hotspawn order. Anyone copying odds from HLTV/EGamersWorld must swap them for these rows.

The EGamersWorld copies this session received were sometimes cached. Each page's countdown shows when it was rendered (e.g. 22:00:36 UTC for a copy fetched about 22:10). Reading times on this page use that render time where it was visible, not the fetch time.

Many 'bookmakers' on EGamersWorld show identical prices (e.g. Spinbetter, 22bet and 1xBit; PlanBet, Herospin, Kinbet, SpinAlto and RedSport), which suggests a shared odds feed. The consensus here is the median over distinct price sets, not over book names, so clones are not double-counted.

The odds printed at the top of an EGamersWorld match page belong to one geo-targeted partner and can differ from the matches-listing price (9z vs Aurora: page headline 3.3 / 1.26, listing 3.86 / 1.21 in P-02, both around 22:00 UTC). Neither alone is a consensus.

HLTV's match-page betting section showed only a US sweepstakes ad with no prices for this reader, so HLTV was used for format, kickoff and identity only. HLTV's 'Pick a winner' user vote is not a betting line and is not used.
